stages.prompt: *Kel scuffs his boot in the dirt.* "...I used to whittle, you know. Haven't picked it back up in years. Lost the last thing I ever carved. Silly to miss a piece of wood this much."
stages.journal_text: Give Kel a wooden horse carving.

paths.on_complete_message: *Kel Blushes* ...You're giving this to me? It's beautiful. Thank you. Really."
